name: Dark Sigil heals for 15% of critical damage dealt (#3728)
contract: Dark Sigil 560535 ships two effects in Spell.dbc. Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with aura 290 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT, BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3% and radius index 12, handled natively by AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct - that is the tooltip's "Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3%". Effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 354, BasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = the 15% of "you now heal for 15% of all critical damage dealt", and TriggerSpell Bloodlord's Curse 707449, a SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL with BasePoints 0. Aura 354 has no AuraEffectHandler entry, no AuraEffect::HandleProc case and is not an isTriggerAura, so no SpellProcEntry was generated and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0: the leech half healed nothing. Valanar's Vengeance 572795 is the probe - the rank a level-80 character owns, a pure SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE with no leech of its own - and spell_crit_rating 10000 makes every hit a critical, which the scenario checks before relying on it. The caster is put in combat before the measured cast because Player::RegenerateHealth adds nothing while in combat, so a health gain can only come from the proc; every combat precondition is asserted rather than assumed. TIMING: 572795 has CastingTimeIndex 171 and SpellCastTimes.dbc row 171 is 6000 ms, while combat only starts when the spell launches on its target (Spell.cpp:8475), so every window that has to see a cast land is 9000 ms, not 5000. COST: 572795 is PowerType -2 (POWER_HEALTH) with ManaCost 50 and ManaCostPercentage 30, so SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost (SpellInfo.cpp:3021) charges 50 plus 30% of GetCreateHealth and Spell::CheckPower (Spell.cpp:7282) refuses the cast unless current health is strictly above that. The fixture health is therefore 4000, not 1000, and the scenario asserts spell_power_cost stays under it instead of assuming a number. Because the cast itself spends far more health than the 15% leech returns, a health reading taken before the cast can never show the leech; the measurement is differential instead. Both legs start from exactly 4000 and pay the same cost, so the health left after the untalented cast (after_control) is the zero point, and what the talented leg has above it is the heal.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The fixture rating guarantees a critical hit
SETUP: the probe's health cost fits inside the 4000 fixture health
The caster is in combat, so health regeneration is off
Let the 6 sec cast, its health cost and its critical hit resolve
SETUP: combat still holds, so no regeneration enters the measurement
Control: without the talent the critical hit only spends health, it heals nothing
Zero point: 4000 minus the cast's health cost, with no leech
The raid critical-strike aura adds its shipped 3%
Let the 6 sec cast, its health cost and its critical hit resolve
SETUP: combat still holds, so no regeneration enters the measurement
DISCRIMINATING: Dark Sigil heals its caster from the critical hit
